summary.headline: Astrological Chapter Catalogue
summary.text: Catalog of chapters 39–73 of a Greek astrological codex, covering questions about childbirth, sex of the unborn, illness and death, planetary and stellar natures, zodiacal tables, lots, slaves, marriage, thieves, partnerships, lawsuits, war, inheritance, and decans. Chapter 67 cites Hermes Trismegistus.
